title: Replace hardcoded Color/Colors literals with theme tokens across tutoring screens
why: ~33 sites across 6 screens (tutor_audit_log_screen.dart 11, accept_invite_screen.dart 8, decline_invite_screen.dart 6, invite_tutor_screen.dart 4, manage_tutors_screen.dart 2, manage_grants_screen.dart 2) use inline Color(0xFF...)/Colors.x.shadeN instead of AppColors/theme.colorScheme, despite AppColors already existing and being used one line away in decline_invite_screen.dart (AppColors.statusWarningSoft next to a raw Color(0xFFB07A00) for the same icon). This is exactly what the repo's own (currently non-enforcing) no_color_literal_outside_theme custom lint targets, and blocks a future dark-mode/theme change from reaching these surfaces consistently.
recommendation: Add the missing semantic tokens to AppColors/AppTheme (status colors per TutorAuditAction, success/warning circles) and replace the literals; this is likely a repo-wide pattern worth fixing via the lint once custom_lint is unbroken, not just in tutoring.
acceptance_criteria: Once custom_lint is fixed, `dart run custom_lint` reports zero no_color_literal_outside_theme hits under lib/features/tutoring/.

corrections: Scope is broader than stated: tutor_pin_entry_gate_screen.dart (3), tutor_pin_reset_screen.dart (4 raw + 1 correct AppColors), tutor_pin_setup_screen.dart (3) also have uncounted raw Color literals — true total ~43 sites across 9 files, not 33/6.

decline_invite_screen.dart has 5 real color-literal violations (221,306,310,372,376), not 6 — the finding's own evidence item at line 217 (AppColors.statusWarningSoft) is the compliant token used for contrast, not itself a violation; total is ~32 sites, not 33.
